raj_product: Tue AM works. I'll block 45m so we can rehearse the ask.
mira_cs: Great. I'll compile a two-slide 'renewal ask' with options A/B and associated risks/costs. Drop anything you want highlighted by Mon noon.

mira_cs: Thanks team. Final note: capture acceptance criteria for each action in the slide notes (e.g., `chart shows 30% cost reduction in scenario B`).
